goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.page: The Hydrogen Snowboard | Hydrogen Demo Store
findings.problem: After pressing Add to Cart the cart dialog first announced it was empty (Looks like you havent added anything yet) with focus on Close panel; the item only appeared after I re-read. No live announcement that the item was added.

findings.page: The Hydrogen Snowboard | Hydrogen Demo Store
findings.problem: Variant options (Color, Size, Binding mount) are plain links with no indication which is selected, and the Ember color swatch is named only Ember; I could not tell which variant would be added.
Cookie dialog Decline: focus moved to Decline fine, but afterwards focus was lost (nothing focused) rather than returned to the page.
Product link names are very long and repeat image alt text, e.g. Picture of The Full Stack Snowboard The Full Stack Snowboard, plus Sale label and prices unseparated.

element.name: Hydrogen snowboard. Front and back. Sale The Hydrogen Snowboard $500 $649.95

findings.problem: On arrival the checkout page showed only an empty main and an unnamed heading with no loading message; the real form appeared only after I re-read. Also the contact area has no field named for full name or phone in the delivery group (First name optional, Last name only), and the Address field is a combobox with no explanation.
